terms.title: Saray Termino tan Kondisyon
terms.s1_body: Diad pan-access o pan-usar ed MyFutureAbroad, onabobon ka ya unoren irayan Termino tan Kondisyon. No agka onabobon, paki-pangasi, agmo usaren so platform.
terms.s2_body: Say MyFutureAbroad et mangiiter na impormasyon tan saray kagawaan pian ontulong ed saray indibidual ya manplaplano ya onalis ed abroad. Say platform et para labat ed personal, aliwan komersyal ya panag-usar. Ag mo nepeg ya gamiten na aliwa odino abusuen so anggan anton feature na serbisyo.
terms.s3_body: Pansisikapan mi ya pansiansiaen ya susto so impormasyon nipaakar ed visa tan serbisyo, balet anggapoy garantiya mi. Mabetbet ya manbabaliw iray totontonen na imigrasyon — lawas ya i-beripika iray detalye ed saray opisyal ya panlalapuan na gobyerno antis ya mandesisyon.
terms.s4_body: Say MyFutureAbroad et mangikokonekta ed saray serbisyo na third-party (singa bilang say Trip.com, saray service provider). Ag kami responsable ed saray laman, inkaduga, o gawa na sarayan third-party.
terms.s5_body: Diad sankabalgan ya abuloyan na ley, say MyFutureAbroad et ag manbayar ed antokaman ya aliwan direkta, aksidente, o resulta na danyos ya nanlapud pan-usar mo ed sayan platform.
terms.s6_body: Nayarin i-update mi irayan Termino pan-panahon. Say itutuloy ya pan-usar na plataporma kayari na saray pananguman et mankabaliksan na pan-awat ed saray balon Termino.
terms.s7_body: Para ed antokaman ya tepet nipaakar ed sarayan Termino, ipangasi yon kontaken kami diad Support page.

privacy.title: Pakaamta ed Pribasidad
privacy.s1_body: Say MyFutureAbroad et sakey a plataporma ya ontutulong ed saray indibidual ya manplano tan man-manage na pan-akar da ed abroad. Saray reperensya ed "we", "us", o "our" et ontutukoy ed MyFutureAbroad.
privacy.s2_title: 2. Anto so Datos ya Aalapen Mi
privacy.s2_body: Titiponen mi so impormasyon ya iter mo no manggawa ka na account (ngaran, email address) tan say data ya nagagawa ed panamegley na pan-usar mo ed platform (singa bilang: saray aka-save ya visa, checklist, dokumento, mensahe).
privacy.s3_title: 3. No Panon Mi ya Usaren so Data Mo
privacy.s3_body: Say data yo et uusaren pian mangiter tan mamapasanting ed serbisyo na MyFutureAbroad, personalisaren so eksperiensya yo, tan makitongtong ed sikayo nipaakar ed account o saray booking yo. Agmi ilalako so personal a data yo ed saray komatlon partido.
privacy.s4_body: Say data yo et ligtas ya aka-store gamit so Supabase. I-implementa mi ray standard ed industriya ya security measures pian protektaan so impormasyon yo.
privacy.s5_body: Gagamiten mi so browser local storage pian natandaan iray pilim (singa bilang, tema, panangawat ed permiso). Anggapoy tracking cookies ya ikakarga ed device mo no anggapoy permiso.
privacy.s6_body: Walay karapatan yo ya i-access, itama, o i-delete so personal a datos yo ed antokaman ya oras. Pian nagawaan irayan karapatan, kontaken kami panamegley na Support page.
privacy.s7_body: Nayarin i-update mi iyan Privacy Notice pan-panahon. Ipaamta mi ed sikayo iray importantin pananguman diad panamegley na email odino sakey ya notipikasyon ed loob na app.
privacy.s8_body: Para ed antokaman ya tepet nipaakar ed pribasidad, ipangasi yon makitongtong ed Support page.
